lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba₂Cu₄O₈ (reduced formula BaCu₂O₄) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral CuO₄ environments for Cu centers, with Cu–O neighbor distances of 1.82–1.96 Å, while Ba centers show eight O neighbors at 2.79–3.06 Å. Corner-sharing between CuO₄ tetrahedra and edge-sharing between Ba 8-vertex polyhedra and CuO₄ tetrahedra are observed, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
